question: Name an alkylbenzene widely used as a chemical intermediate in the production of phenol.
solution:
Correct Answer **Cumene**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **One alkylbenzene** widely used as a** chemical intermediate** in the production of **phenol** is **cumene (isopropylbenzene).**
 
• **Cumene** is oxidized to** cumene hydroperoxide,** which is then cleaved to **phenol and acetone.**
 
• This process is known as the **cumene process** and is one of the most important methods for the commercial production of **phenol.**
